code:
# Create a new Worker project from the official template
npm create cloudflare@latest hello-worker

# When prompted: choose "Hello World" Worker, JavaScript, skip git questions if unsure

# Enter the project directory
cd hello-worker

# Start the local development server (hot-reload: edit, save, test, repeat)
npx wrangler dev

# Your Worker runs at http://localhost:8787 - open it in a browser or use curl
description: Commands that create a new Worker project from the official template and start the local development server.

steps.description: `npm create cloudflare@latest hello-worker` scaffolds a new Worker project from the official template.
The comment names the prompts: choose the Hello World Worker, JavaScript, and skip the git questions if unsure.
`cd hello-worker` enters the new project directory.
`npx wrangler dev` starts the local development server. It hot-reloads on every save, so you edit, save, and test without redeploying.
